metadata.hypothesis_title: Thalamocortical Coupling Mediates White Matter Integrity and Thalamic Morphology via DMN Connectivity in Insomnia

critic_findings.message: Missing key variables FA and thalamus_volume from DTI and MRI, which were central to the original mediation pathway.
critic_findings.recommendation: Use available fMRI proxies (salience_FC, frontoparietal_FC) as outcomes and revise the mediation model to focus on fMRI data.

critic_findings.message: Only 70 subjects with available data may limit the statistical power of the analysis.
critic_findings.recommendation: Consider increasing sample size or using more robust statistical methods to mitigate power issues.
